defects.class: signed/unsigned capacity test can skip reallocation of an ASN1_STRING buffer
defects.description: string_set_body compared `s.length as usize` against the new length. A negative length, reachable through the exported ASN1_STRING_length_set, became a huge usize, so the resize was skipped and a longer payload was copied into the existing buffer. The authority compares the signed int and reallocates.
defects.fix: The negative-length arm now reallocates. Control: asn1::string::tests::a_negative_length_forces_the_set_to_reallocate.

defects.class: unchecked length sum used for allocation (AGENTS.md section 3)
defects.description: ossl_sk_ASN1_UTF8STRING2text accumulated the joined length and then allocated length + 1 with unchecked arithmetic. Negative ASN1_STRING lengths were converted with `as usize`. The authority has the same implicit size_t arithmetic; the crate must not reproduce the wrapping.
defects.fix: Both additions and the +1 now use checked_add; each element length is converted with usize::try_from and a negative value refuses with NULL. This is a deliberate section 17 divergence for invalid string state.

defects.class: negative content length copied as a huge extent
defects.description: ex_i2c copied whenever `len != 0`. A negative length on a live ASN1_STRING made `len as usize` huge and passed it to copy_nonoverlapping. The authority's memcpy with a negative length is undefined.
defects.fix: The copy now requires len > 0. This eliminates the authority's UB rather than reproducing it (AGENTS.md section 17).

src/mac/cmac.rs: staged allocation, cleanup order and cleansing, copy refusal, init restart/key arms, Update burst arithmetic and Final padding; block-size bounds match the authority's own EVP_MAX_BLOCK_LENGTH assumption.
src/evp/p5_crpt2.rs: NULL normalisations, PBKDF2 parameter construction, second key-length read, salt type test, cleanse-on-error and cipher/digest fetch releases.

src/des/mod.rs: key schedule, parity/weak-key helpers, c2l/l2cn extents, string-to-key truncation and every mode loop. DES_cfb_encrypt/DES_ede3_cfb_encrypt use unsigned length exactly as the authority (`register unsigned long l = length`).

src/asn1/i2d.rs: two-pass sizing, SET OF scratch ownership and sort, checked template/sequence sums, apart from the repaired negative-length copy.
src/x509/x509_req.rs: X509_to_X509_REQ version-block transfer, extension attribute decode/add/replace tails and single-release paths.
observations_not_repaired: src/des/mod.rs DES_cfb_encrypt computes numbits+7 before the range check, as the authority does; an INT_MAX numbits differs only between a debug overflow panic and the authority's C UB, so it is recorded rather than changed.
